limitations: Custom duration/boundary screening metrics on procedural audio. No real-recording validation or production selection.

plugin.decoder: HMM/Viterbi unconditional in this pinned source; README mentions an older optional heuristic mode

vamp_sdk.license: MIT-style permission notice with name-promotion restriction; embedded KissFFT BSD-3-Clause (see official COPYING)

build_commands.command: make -f Makefile.osx -B -j4 CXX=clang++ CC=clang VAMP_SDK_DIR=../vamp-plugin-sdk BOOST_ROOT=../boost_1_87_0 ARCHFLAGS='-mmacosx-version-min=11.0 -arch arm64' OPTFLAGS=-O3 LDFLAGS='-mmacosx-version-min=11.0 -arch arm64 -dynamiclib -install_name nnls-chroma.dylib ../vamp-plugin-sdk/build/libvamp-sdk.a -exported_symbols_list vamp-plugin.list -framework Accelerate'
clang++ -std=c++11 -O3 -arch arm64 -mmacosx-version-min=11.0 -I vamp-plugin-sdk chordino-host.cpp vamp-plugin-sdk/build/libvamp-hostsdk.a -o chordino-host

host_semantics.input: RIFF PCM16 mono WAV; 8000-192000 Hz; 512 MiB maximum
host_semantics.output: # JSON metadata header, then seconds TAB native_label
host_semantics.processing: sliding preferred-size blocks centered at provided sample timestamp, with initial half-window and file-tail zero padding
host_semantics.normalization: native Chordino always adds final N at last processed center; remove exactly that last feature before interval conversion
